Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e portare a mercato l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture, ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia (ibrido valutabile) Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: ricercatore universitario/ricercatrice universitaria
description: Il nostro Cliente è un Power Producer nel settore rinnovabili e ci ha incaricato di ricercare la figura di HEAD OF PROJECT DEVELOPMENT & CONSTRUCTION - impianti energia rinnovabili La risorsa, rispondendo al Managing Director Operations, garantirà lo sviluppo, l'ingegneria e la realizzazione degli impianti rinnovabili del Gruppo assicurando la gestione end-to- end del ciclo di vita dei progetti. Si dedicherà in particolare allo scouting e alla valutazione siti, al permitting, all'engineering, al procurement, alla costruzione e al commissioning ai fini di assicurarne la consegna nei tempi previsti nel rispetto dei budget CAPEX approvati, degli standard QHSE. Effettua la pulizia e la manutenzione delle macchine con l'aria compressa e appositi panni. Effettua il rabbocco dell'olio nei macchinari utilizzati. Gestisce l'inventario utilizzando il conto manuale e la bilancia di precisione contapezzi con cui si contano i componenti presenti in reparto. Si interfaccia con area UT per lo sviluppo di campioni e/o per l'effettuazione di test funzionali. Interagisce con Area CQ per risolvere possibili NC emerse durante il ciclo produttivo. Utilizza quotidianamente attrezzature e strumenti da banco (quali a titolo di esempio trapani, pinze, cacciaviti) per ottimizzare l'assemblaggio meccanico. title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

description:

We are currently looking for a Technical Development Manager to SSAB Special Steels in Italy.

About the position
SSAB is a highly-specialized global steel company driven by close customer relationships. SSAB Develops high-strength steels and provides services for better perfomance and sustainability. The company is a leading producer on the global market for Advanced High-Strength Steels (AHSS) and Quenched & Tempered Steel (Q&T), strip, plate and tubular products, as well as construction solutions.
As Technical Development Manager, you are playing an important role of supporting SSAB’s customers with your technical competence and support in order to build customer value and profitability. The role also includes close collaboration with Tech support, product development, production and quality. Your geographical business area will be Italy, Greece and Switzerland. You will be traveling approximately 3-4 days a week to meet customers and also to visit SSAB’s mill in Oxelösund, Sweden.

Application
Send your application no later than 24th of September 2018

In this recruitment we collaborate with Hudson.

For more information, please contact
Fredrik Ålund, Researcher, 076-631 94 44

We decline contacts from recruitment agencies and ad sellers regarding this advertisement.
SSAB is a Nordic and US-based steel company. SSAB offers value added products and services developed in close cooperation with its customers to create a stronger, lighter and more sustainable world. SSAB has employees in over 50 countries. SSAB has production facilities in Sweden, Finland and the US. SSAB is listed on the NASDAQ OMX Nordic Exchange in Stockholm and has a secondary listing on the NASDAQ OMX in Helsinki. www.ssab.com

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

Associate Professor or Assistant Professor (promotion track) in Psychiatry

About us

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character. Interdisciplinarity in research and teaching is key to the University's approach to addressing tomorrow's societal challenges. Embedded in Luxembourg's diverse and multicultural society, the University offers a welcoming, multilingual environment where students and researchers from around the world feel at home. Its human size fosters close interaction between students and lecturers, creating a personal atmosphere. With 1,600 members of academic staff for 6,700+ students and 1,000+ Ph.D. candidates, students feel connected and valued on their academic journey. Internationally recognised research drives innovation in digital transformation, health, and sustainable development. This scientific progress is supported by cutting-edge infrastructure and a national commitment to education, research, and innovation. The dynamics of a young university offer rare potential and scope for exploring new ideas.

The Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) is part of the Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine of the University of Luxembourg. DHML coordinates all teaching programmes in medicine, life sciences, nursing, radiography and midwifery. Research at the department integrates basic and translational, molecular and computational approaches with a focus on cancer biology, as well as clinical research projects on human health and disease. Related research within the University encompasses clinical psychology and cognitive sciences at the Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences (FHSE) and research on neurological disorders and dementia at the Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine (LCSB).

The DHML cooperates with national health care centres and with leading international biomedical research institutions. The University of Luxembourg has set a strategic focus on medicine and health and is actively developing its training and research areas in these domains, creating exceptional opportunities in medical, biomedical and mental health initiatives.

Your role

As part of the University's expansion of its medical and health sciences portfolio, the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences seeks to appoint a Professor in Psychiatry. The successful candidate will establish and lead the medical specialisation programme (Diplômes d'Études Spécialisées – DES) in psychiatry, contribute to ongoing initiatives for mental health support and develop a strong line of research in a related field.

The position combines innovative postgraduate teaching in psychiatry with the development of an interdisciplinary research programme, supported by state-of-the-art infrastructure and excellent possibilities for collaborative work, particularly in neurosciences, clinical psychology and cognitive sciences.

The professorship represents a rare opportunity to shape the further development of medical education and research at the University of Luxembourg in close cooperation with colleagues across the University as well as with local and international hospitals.

The successful candidate will:

• Design, develop and implement a modern, state-of-the-art psychiatry curriculum
• Lead the medical specialisation programme in psychiatry and coordinate psychiatry-related teaching activities within the University's study programmes in medicine and other health-related sciences
• Collaborate with faculty colleagues and clinical partners to ensure an integrated and cohesive learning experience for students
• Implement innovative educational approaches and digital learning resources to provide students with comprehensive and engaging learning opportunities
• Establish research activities in psychiatry or related disciplines
• Integrate into ongoing research endeavours in mental health, e.g. Department of Behavioural and Cognitive Sciences, and/or neurosciences, e.g. Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine
• Supervise Master students and PhD candidates
• Contribute to translational efforts in advancing mental health care, e.g. early detection, prevention, innovative treatments, integration of digital solutions
• Engage in clinical psychiatry in Luxembourg

For further information about the role, please contact: Professor Serge Haan, Head of the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences,

Email: Serge.Haan@uni.lu

Your profile

• MD degree and PhD or equivalent doctoral qualification
• Relevant clinical qualification in psychiatry and significant clinical experience; at least 5 years of practice
• Robust experience in teaching psychiatry at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level
• Authorization or eligibility to apply for authorization to practice as a psychiatrist in Luxembourg
• Proven commitment to interdisciplinary and innovative teaching
• Experience in designing and implementing new educational programmes or courses at university level
• Familiarity with modern teaching methods and tools, including online learning platforms and simulation-based training
• Strong track record in clinical and/or biomedical research in a relevant domain, with international recognition, a focus on therapeutic processes and/or aetiological research on mental disorders will be considered an asset
• Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to build and sustain academic and clinical partnerships, particularly with partner universities and healthcare institutions
• Visionary and transformational leadership skills, ability to thrive in a dynamic and pioneering academic environment

Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer

• A strategic opportunity to shape and lead the development of psychiatry education and research within an interdisciplinary environment and a growing medical faculty
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research-Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance

How to apply

BGL BNP Paribas is one of the largest banks in Luxembourg and part of the BNP Paribas Group.

It offers an especially wide range of financial products and bancassurance solutions to individuals, professionals, businesses and private banking clients.

In 2024, BGL BNP Paribas was named “Best Bank in Luxembourg” by Euromoney and in 2025, for the 10th consecutive year, was awarded the “Top Employer Luxembourg” certification, in recognition of the excellent working conditions offered to its employees.

CREDIT STRUCTURER M/F
permanent contract

CONTEXT AND CHALLENGES

Credit Structurers are key stakeholders of Banque des Entreprises Luxembourg, on whom the Bank can rely for their expertise and objectivity in the analysis and structuring of corporate and SME financing while combining a risk awareness and commercial approach.

WHAT'S YOUR DAY-TO-DAY MISSION?

As Credit Structurer, you will be responsible with the Relationship Managers for:
• Gathering appropriate client/transaction/internal information (eg : annual reports, organization chart, broker-sector-rating reports, due diligence memos, budget, treasury plan, business plan, internal memos …)
• Properly structure, negotiate with the client and present in credit committees new transactions and credit annual reviews of existing transactions, with the objectives of optimizing the return and risk management of the bank, within the context of the global client relationship while taking into account the objectives, procedures and risk appetite of the bank, i.e.:
o Analysis of the information received/collected with a primary focus on financial-, rating- and credit analysis,
o Structuring credit term sheets (determining the adequate facility type, borrower, guarantor, amount, maturity, pricing, financial covenants, security…),
o With the Relationship Managers delivering a complete, synthetic, critical and coherent up-to-date credit memo on the client,/ transaction, based on facts, compliant with the bank's guidelines and with a summary of the main risks & mitigants enabling credit committee members to take an informed decision,
o Lead the credit process with Risk colleagues

description:
Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & Group MLRO

Purpose of the Job

Quintet Private Bank is a leading private bank in the wealth management sector; we are committed to our clients and their families, and pride ourselves on our personalised service based on a deep understanding of what clients want to achieve. We are a bank headquartered in Luxembourg with branches in Belgium, Denmark, Germany, and the Netherlands, as well as a subsidary in the UK. We want our employees to feel proud of being part of a company that is committed to do the right thing. You will have the opportunity to grow your career while developing personally and professionally through various resources and programmes.

The Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & MLRO has primary responsibility for implementation, oversight and monitoring of the Group's financial crime compliance framework (across money laundering & terrorist financing, sanctions, bribery & corruption, external fraud risks), ensuring robust risk management, full regulatory compliance, and effective detection and reporting of financial crime, thereby safeguarding the integrity, reputation, and resilience of the organisation. The role holder acts as the central point of contact with competent authorities and the FIU on financial crime (including specifically AML/CFT ) matters.

Key Accountabilities

Group AML/CFT Framework Leadership:

• Define, implement and maintain a consistent and effective Group-wide FCC framework aligned with applicable regulations and group risk appetite  across all entities.
• Ensure policies, procedures and control expectations are defined, implemented and maintained.    

Group Financial Crime Risk Stewardship:

• Oversee the effectiveness of the financial crime risk control framework .  
• Provide advice,  guidance and challenge to the 1LoD risk and control ownership.  
• Coordinate and maintain the group-wide financial crime risk assessment.

Client Due Diligence Oversight:

• Oversee the effectiveness of client due diligence and client acceptance processes.
• Ensure higher risk clients are subject to enhanced due diligence.
• Monitor compliance with client onboarding and periodic review requirements.            
                        
Suspicious Activity Reporting Oversight:

• Oversee the effectiveness of transaction monitoring and client/transaction screening arrangements including systems/toolings.
• Act as ultimate escalation point for suspicious activity, investigate complex cases and ensure timely and compliant reporting to FIUs.                                    

Regulatory Engagement & Representation:

• Serve as primary contact for regulators, leading inspections, managing regulatory interactions, overseeing regulatory reporting and ensuring remediation of findings for financial crime matters.                                    

Group MLRO Network & Local Oversight:

• Lead and coordinate local MLROs, ensuring consistent governance, escalation, independence and oversight across jurisdictions.
Governance, Board Reporting & Advisory:
• Provide regular FCC reporting to senior management and the Board, advising on risk exposure, control effectiveness and mitigation strategies.
• Ensure escalation of major financial crime risk events, breaches or control issues, ensuring appropriate reporting, documentation and remediation.

Culture, Training & Awareness:

• Promote a strong compliance culture throughout the organisation by designing and delivering effective AML/CFT training and awareness across all levels of the organisation

Knowledge and Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Law, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Advanced degree or professional certification (e.g., CAMS, CFE) preferred.
• Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in financial crime compliance within the financial services industry (Larger bank / big four preferred), with a focus on AML, ABC, sanctions, and policy framework.
• In-depth knowledge of European and UK regulatory requirements related to financial crime compliance, including AML directives, sanctions regimes, and bribery/corruption laws.

We investigate mechanisms that govern tumor initiation, migration and invasion, metastasis, cell cycle control, the tumor microenvironment and drug resistance by using a combination of experimental in vitro, in vivo and in silico approaches. Next to its research mission, DLSM is coordinating all teaching programs in Life Sciences, Medicine, Nursing and Allied Health Professions.

The position focuses on innovative, interdisciplinary teaching in histology (and histopathology) at the bachelor's level and within medical specialization programmes, while also offering access to state-of-the-art infrastructure to support high level research in related fields. As part of its strategic expansion, the DHML is offering candidates a range of opportunities to access leadership positions, including study programme directors and domain coordinators, according to the needs and development of the medical programmes. The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences (FHSE) at the University of Luxembourg brings together expertise from the humanities, linguistics, cognitive sciences, social and educational sciences. People from across 20 disciplines are working within the Faculty. Along with the disciplinary approach a very ambitious interdisciplinary research culture has been developed. The faculty's research and teaching focuses on social, economic, political and educational issues with the common goal of contributing to an inclusive, open and resourceful society.

Your role

The cohesion of liberal societies increasingly depends on high-quality, participatory human services spanning social, educational, and cultural domains. Strategies for reducing barriers to service uptake and enhancement, including through the co-production of specialist knowledge, are essential for the legitimacy of services and underlying policies. The University of Luxembourg aims to play a key role in this public-facing co-productive knowledge landscape. This position will contribute to the development of digital and face-to-face methods for public involvement, by shaping the theories, methodologies, and tools that underpin participatory knowledge production in human services. Active in research, innovation and teaching, the position holder will, in particular:

• Analyse and develop innovative approaches to service user engagement, public outreach, and multi-stakeholder dialogue focusing on unequal power relations and conﬂicting interests. These approaches should combine data-intensive digital tools with face-to-face interventions, enabling exchanges between human service providers and hard-to-reach populations. Examples include collaborative digital platforms, co-creative living labs, interactive exhibitions, and multisensorial participatory interventions
• Organize participatory events and lead the development of the department's outreach initiative ALICES (Agora Luxembourgeoise partICipative de l'intErvention Sociale) - a living lab launched in 2023 that engages with Luxembourg's human services sector
• Design and theorise participatory interventions and public outreach within the context of human services as well as in empirical research methods
• Teach conceptual and methodological courses in the Bachelor en Sciences Sociales et Éducatives (BSSE), playing a key a key role in its ongoing development and expansion. The postholder will also have the opportunity to contribute to the construction of a projected new Master's programme and to teach within the doctoral and lifelong learning programmes of the university

description:

Arendt & Medernach is the leading independent business law firm in Luxembourg with over 800 professionals. The firm's international team of more than 450 legal experts represents Luxembourg and foreign clients in all areas of Luxembourg business law from its main office in Luxembourg and representative offices in Frankfurt, Hong Kong, London, New York, and Paris.

Our service to clients is differentiated by the end-to-end specialist advice we offer, covering all legal, regulatory, taxation, and advisory aspects of doing business in Luxembourg.

Our firm advises international and domestic clients in all areas of business law relevant to their business activities, ranging from fund formation, banking, insurance, private equity, and real estate to corporate and tax matters.

Given the ongoing development of our firm, we are currently recruiting:
‎
Senior Data Management Officer (DMO)

Your Role:

You will join the Data Management Office (DMO) and play a key role in driving its implementation, governance and continuous development. The DMO has a broader remit covering the quality, integrity and lifecycle management of Client, Payor, Matter and related master data across the firm. Your responsibilities include:

• Driving the design, rollout and continuous improvement of the DMO operating model, including scope, roles, controls, governance routines and interfaces with other departments;
• Defining, maintaining and enforcing firm-wide standards for Client, Payor, Matter and related master data, including validation rules, ownership principles and escalation paths;
• Overseeing the DMO contribution to the redesigned Central Business Intake process and ensuring that key information is validated before being introduced or amended in the firm's systems;
• Designing and supervising centralised processes for entity lifecycle management in our ERP, including legal name changes, address changes, corporate actions, record inactivation, mergers and other third-party data events;
• Leading duplicate prevention, analysis and clean-up initiatives, prioritising remediation backlogs and coordinating stakeholders to address root causes;
• Structuring and leading third-party data enrichment activities, including VAT ID, EUID, business register ID and other identifiers required for reliable operations, compliance, billing and reporting;
• Coordinating with owners of satellite applications to ensure that major master data changes are shared and reflected consistently across systems;
• Leading or contributing to transformation projects impacting master datas, including requirements definition, testing, deployment, adoption and post-implementation follow-up;
• Creating and maintaining DMO procedures, working instructions, control checklists, data dictionaries, accountability matrices, training materials, KPIs and management reporting;
• Coaching DMO Officer(s), reviewing complex cases and promoting a culture of data accuracy, accountability and continuous improvement.

Your Profile:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent experience, in finance operations, data governance, process management, business transformation or a comparable field;
• You have significant experience in master data management, data quality, data governance, process excellence or cross-functional operations;
• You have proven experience leading implementation, data clean-up, operating model or transformation projects;
• You are able to define standards, controls, KPIs, procedures and practical governance routines;
• You combine strong analytical and documentation skills with a pragmatic approach to implementation;
• You have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills and are comfortable facilitating workshops across departments;
• You are able to influence without direct authority while maintaining independence, objectivity and governance discipline;
• You have a good understanding of ERP, CRM, compliance and finance data flows; knowledge of Elite is a strong asset;
• You are fluent in English; French and/or German are considered an asset

We Offer:

• Excellent career development opportunities with tailor-made internal training focused on both technical and soft skills;
• An entrepreneurial work culture where we promote talent & ideas;
• Multicultural, diverse teams encouraging collaborative work;
• The opportunity to work and interact within a wide network of specialists; and
• A hybrid working environment offering flexibility and the possibility to work from home.

About us

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance (FDEF) at the University of Luxembourg offers a unique academic and research environment.
Rooted in Luxembourg but with a European and international outlook, teaching and research benefit from the proximity of the European institutions, Luxembourg's leading international financial centre and its vibrant business community. Institutional and private sector partnerships, sponsored Chairs and a growing network of international partner universities make the FDEF a dynamic academic hub at the heart of Europe.

Your role

You will:

• Conduct independent research in the above-mentioned fields and contribute to the Department's and Faculty's research strategy, in particular on sustainability: environmental, social and institutional
• Publish high-quality scientific work in internationally recognised outlets and participate in editorial or scientific committees where appropriate
• Identify and secure external research funding, prepare competitive funding applications and manage research projects
• Organise and contribute to scientific events, e.g., conferences, workshops, seminars, at national and international level
• Teach public law at Bachelor and Master levels, in particular public economic and financial law, parliamentary law and legal methodology
• Supervise Master's theses and, subject to obtaining the ADR, supervise doctoral candidates and contribute to doctoral training
• Engage in knowledge transfer and outreach activities and develop professional networks with public institutions and other stakeholders in Luxembourg and abroad
The Research Scientist will join the Department of Law (FDEF) and the research area Public and Tax Law. The position focuses on research and teaching in European and Luxembourg public economic and financial law, monetary law, economic regulation, parliamentary law and legal philosophy.
For more information about this role, please contact: Prof. Luc Heuschling, luc.heuschling@uni.lu

Your profile:

• PhD in Public Law obtained at least 5 years ago, with a strong academic record and proven capacity for independent research
• Solid expertise in European and Luxembourg public economic and financial law, in particular public finance, monetary law and economic regulation; additional expertise in parliamentary law and/or legal philosophy is a strong asset
• Strong track record of publications in recognised peer reviewed journals and collective volumes
• Demonstrated experience in designing, leading and managing research projects, including successful applications for external funding
• Teaching experience in public economic law at Bachelor and/or Master level in higher education; ability to teach several areas of public law, e.g. public economic and financial law, parliamentary law, methodology, and to supervise Master's theses and participate in examination boards
• Marked interest in interdisciplinarity and in collaboration with other disciplines and non academic partners; commitment to knowledge transfer and public outreach
• Good IT skills, in particular for the conception and management of open access or open edition publication platforms; strong organisational skills and ability to work both independently and in a team
• Excellent communication and writing skills, and motivation to contribute to the strategic development of the Department of Law and the Faculty
• Experience with research assessment exercises and research evaluation schemes

Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must have an excellent command of English and either French or German (C1). The University encourages its staff to learn additional languages and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance

All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.

title: Senior AI/ML & Data Engineer + technical Lead (m/f)
description:
The position to be filled

adwäisEO is looking for an experienced AI & Data Technical lead to define and drive the technical strategy of its data team in support of innovative Earth Observation (EO) data valorization, and to carry out projects as project manager, expert, developer or operator in a small team of 3 people to be embedded in a larger team made of the grouping of sister companies' teams.

The role is centered around the survey, design, development, optimization and deployment of state-of-the-art machine learning/deep learning algorithms as well as the training & deployment of generative AI models (geo-VLM) to enhance current workflow on EO imagery processing & analysis.

The candidate will work on the development of deep learning and AI processes to support the generation of innovative new data derived information. The activities will include the development of advanced models and pipelines such as foundation model for EO data, Vision transformers and attention-based architecture for multimodal dataset and scalable workflows leveraging High-Performance Computing (HPC).

She/he will be contributing to:

    • Survey of and feedback on technological progress in the deep learning and machine learning technology evolution in the domain,
    • Design and development of deep learning algorithms for EO imagery and related datasets
    • Development of related documentation (Algorithm baseline, functional analysis)
    • Definition of data requirement for processing chain.
    • Writing engineering documentation and technical reports in English.
    • Participation to the Bids and proposals.

Must Have Requirements

Profile

• 5-8 years of experience in AI and data science algorithm development (preferable for satellite Remote Sensing or imagery/video data).

Technical Skills (Hard Skills)

• Experience with Deep Learning and/or simple Machine Learning techniques, attention- based architecture, foundation model (adapting, fine-tuning, evaluating and, where relevant, pre-training foundation models for Earth Observation data -Vision and Large Language models in particular);
• Proficiency in python with solid object-oriented programming practices and experience building modular, scalable pipelines;
• Strong hands-on proficiency in PyTorch; (familiarity with TensorFlow or other ML frameworks is an advantage);
• Hands-on experience with popular specialized libraries (rasterio, xarray, geopandas, terratorch);
• Familiarity with Linux environments;
• Knowledge of Rest API for querying EO data repositories (e.g. STAC), with expertise in creating, validating, and maintaining robust training datasets;
• Demonstrated experience deploying machine learning or deep learning models in production environments;
• Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized AI applications;
• Experience designing, developing and maintaining model inference APIs or services;
• Good understanding of the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle, including data preparation, training, validation, deployment, monitoring, versioning and retraining;
• Hands-on experience with GPU-based training and/or inference, HPC/Slurm;
• Practical experience with at least one production computing environment, such as cloud platforms, Kubernetes-based infrastructures or HPC systems.

Behavior skills (Soft Skills)

• Analytical, critical and proactive mind;
• Very good task prioritization and organization: ability to allocate tasks and track progress;
• Very good technical mentoring (supporting and upskilling junior profiles);
• Very good communication skills: acting as the link between the technical team and management/other departments;
• Fluency in English (spoken and written) is essential;
• High degree of autonomy and decision-making;
• Versatility: comfortable operating at a hands-on capacity while coordinating the team's work.

Being considered as a plus:

• Knowledge of other programming or coding languages such as IDL, C, C++;
• Experience with physical modelling (e.g. hydraulic, hydrology, crop, …);
• MLOps Skills (Docker, microservices);
• Experience with HPC, distributed training, or GPU-accelerated computation;
• Knowledge of Satellite data processing;
• PostDoc in Remote Sensing or ML.

What we offer

❖ A professional, stimulating and human working environment in IT & Earth Observation Data sector based on proximity management,
❖ A real possibility of evolution depending on your involvement in your work,
❖ Lunch vouchers,
❖ Supplementary Health insurance,
❖ Bonuses,
❖ Canteen,
❖ Pleasant premises in the heart of the Luxembourg countryside,
❖ Free car park

Why Join Us?

❖ Be part of innovative projects with strong impact in high-tech and strategic sectors.
❖ Work in an agile, ambitious environment at the heart of a fast-growing industry.
❖ Contribute to the development of cutting-edge solutions and help shape the future of our business.
❖ Join a dynamic and passionate team, committed to excellence and continuous improvement

title: Business Analyst (m/f) (réf. E) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? Administration des contributions directes Missions Les personnes retenues seront affectées à la division informatique de l'Administration des contributions directes (ACD). Elle seront amenées à œuvrer en tant que business analyst sur un portefeuille de projets de tailles variables. Les tâches suivant/antes seront à assurer (liste non limitative): Analyser et modéliser des processus fiscaux/administratifs avec les experts métiers de l'ACD; Traduire des exigences réglementaires complexes en spécifications fonctionnelles actionnables; Participer aux refontes applicatives et aux transformations digitales du cadrage à la mise en production; Collaborer avec le CTIE et les prestataires IT en co-maîtrise d'ouvrage; Contribuer à la montée en maturité des pratiques BA dans le département; Piloter ou co-piloter des initiatives IT stratégiques (cadrage, planning, reporting COPIL/IT Office); Coordonner les parties prenant/antes internes (métier ACD, TMO/PMO.) et externes (CTIE, prestataires, autres administrations); Participer activement aux UAT; Prendre la responsabilité end-to-end de certaines initiatives selon leur taille/complexité. Profil Compétences techniques Expérience professionnelle minimale de plus de 5 ans sur des projets IT significatifs (refonte applicative, transformation ou innovation digitale); Capacité à endosser un rôle de chef de projet sur des initiatives de taille moyenne; Capacité d'analyse et de compréhension de textes législatifs; Capacité à participer à la conduite du changement; Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles; Maitrise obligatoire des langues françaises et anglaises. Compétences comportementales Excellentes capacités d'écoute et relationnelles; Excellente aptitude de travailler en équipe mais aussi de façon autonome; Excellentes capacités à challenger des prestataires; Excellentes capacités organisationnelles. Atouts Certification en gestion de projet ou Business Analyst (Quapital IT, PMP, PRINCE2 ou équivalent); Expérience multi-parties prenant/antes (administration publique, CTIE, MOE externe); Expérience en développement et/ou en implémentation ERP; Expérience significative en méthodologie Agile/Scrum; La maîtrise des langues luxembourgeoise, allemande et anglaise constituant un avantage. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut de l'employé de l'État. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission pour devenir employé de l'État. Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un bachelor en informatique ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 6 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Expérience Vous avez une expérience d'au moins 3 ans dans le domaine. Langues Vous répondez aux exigences de connaissances des 3 langues administratives pour le groupe d'indemnité A2.  Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre de l'Union européenne.

title: CONSEILLER COMMERCIAL RENOVATION (H/F/X)

Notre ambition est de proposer une solution unique à nos clients en prenant en charge l'ensemble de leur projet, de la conception jusqu'à la réalisation.Notre force repose sur un réseau de partenaires et de sous-traitants qualifiés couvrant tous les corps de métier : chauffage, sanitaire, électricité, toiture, menuiserie, peinture, carrelage, isolation, aménagement intérieur et rénovation générale.Qu'il s'agisse d'une salle de bain clé en main, d'un aménagement de combles, d'une rénovation énergétique ou d'une transformation complète de maison, Remake coordonne l'ensemble des intervenants afin d'offrir au client un interlocuteur unique et une gestion simplifiée de son chantier. VOS MISSIONS :Prendre en charge les leads entrants et organiser les rendez-vous clientsComprendre les attentes, contraintes et objectifs du client lors de visites sur siteConseiller les clients dans leurs projets de rénovation, transformation ou amélioration de l'habitatIdentifier les corps de métier nécessaires à la réalisation du projetOrganiser les visites avec les différents partenaires et sous-traitantsCollecter, analyser et consolider les devis de chaque intervenantConstruire une offre globale claire, cohérente et compétitivePrésenter et défendre les solutions proposées auprès des clientsNégocier et finaliser les contratsAssurer le suivi commercial des projets jusqu'à leur lancementDévelopper et entretenir un réseau de partenaires et sous-traitants de qualitéMettre à jour les opportunités commerciales dans notre CRM TYPES DE PROJETS :Selon les projets et les besoins de nos clients, vous intervenez notamment dans les domaines suivants :Les rénovations complètes de maisons et d'appartementsLes transformations intérieuresLes aménagements de comblesLes salles de bain clé en mainLes rénovations énergétiquesLes extensions et réaménagementsLes projets nécessitant l'intervention de plusieurs corps de métier VOTRE PROFIL :Vous aimez le contact client et êtes capable de comprendre rapidement un projet dans sa globalité.Vous savez coordonner plusieurs intervenants, défendre une offre et transformer une opportunité en chantier. Vous disposez de:Une expérience commerciale dans le bâtiment, la rénovation ou la constructionUne bonne compréhension des différents corps de métier du bâtimentUne capacité à dialoguer aussi bien avec des particuliers qu'avec des artisans et entreprises partenairesUne forte orientation client et résultatsUn excellent sens de l'organisationDe l'autonomie et de l'initiativeUne bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques LanguesVous maîtrisez le français.La connaissance de l'allemand ou de l'anglais est un atout.Le luxembourgeois constitue un avantage supplémentaire. Arendt & Medernach is the leading independent business law firm in Luxembourg with over 800 professionals. The firm's international team of more than 450 legal experts represents Luxembourg and foreign clients in all areas of Luxembourg business law from its main office in Luxembourg and representative offices in Frankfurt, Hong Kong, London, New York, and Paris.

Our service to clients is differentiated by the end-to-end specialist advice we offer, covering all legal, regulatory, taxation, and advisory aspects of doing business in Luxembourg.

Our firm advises international and domestic clients in all areas of business law relevant to their business activities, ranging from fund formation, banking, insurance, private equity, and real estate to corporate and tax matters.

Given the ongoing development of our firm, we are currently recruiting:
‎
Paralegal

In the paralegal department at Arendt & Mederenach you will have the opportunity to work in a legal environment marked by excellence. You will work on diverse and interesting files alongside lawyers and benefit from the same training center offered to them. Additionally, our specialized software helps to automize the more tedious work to allow our team to focus other matters.

Your role:

• Handle the day-to-day requests of Arendt's clients on the preparation and submission of legal documentation in relation to regulated and unregulated investment funds (such as the fund formation, the change of managers/directors, amendments to prospectus and/or articles of association, liquidation/dissolution, etc.) or domestic and multinational companies under the supervision of a Senior Paralegal
• Work on a variety of interesting cases without focusing on transactional work;
• Work closely with lawyers to support them on the management of their open files with a variety of prestigious clients;
• Liaise daily with clients, notaries, lawyers (both internally and externally) and authorities (the CSSF particularly);
• Draft standard legal documents (board minutes, incorporation deeds, resolutions, agreements, CSSF letters) and keep logs of all of them;
• Track and check documents (signature, legalization, apostille …);
• Prepare and attend board and general meetings and take minutes;
• Maintain statutory registers;
• Have the opportunity to work in a secondment at one of our clients.

Your profile:

• You have a bachelor's degree in law or an equivalent university degree;
• You ideally have at least two years experience in a similar position in a law firm, investment firm, a corporate service provider, or an interest in the corporate or funds sector;
• You have a perfect command of French and English; German being considered as an asset;
• You are highly organized, rigorous, and understand the importance of deadlines;
• You are proactive, eager to learn, with excellent interpersonal and communication skills;
• You have a perfect command of MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook);
• You may or may not be admitted to the bar, working here allows you to maintain your bar registration.
‎
Within Arendt, we uphold high standards. Our professionals work with clients on engaging projects, empowered from the start. With a strong local presence in Luxembourg and international reach, we support and train our team members to thrive in a culture of excellence. Specialised teams ensure the right skills are available, allowing for a focus on added value. Our leaders are approachable, providing support and mentoring.

We offer a vibrant social life with numerous events, embracing sports and art, our culture encourages openness and discovery beyond the professional realm. With over 50 nationalities represented, Arendt is committed to the well-being of its staff, serving the best interests of its clients, protecting the environment, and supporting education.

Arendt promotes equal opportunities and value each employee for what they bring to the community. For more information, please refer to our diversity and inclusion policy on our website.

Interested?

If you are interested in this job opportunity, we are looking forward to receiving your application.
All applications will be treated confidentially.

Please be aware that the selected candidate will be required to provide a criminal record (or certificate of good conduct).

description:

Location: Luxembourg, LU (Prague, CZ)
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work:

Group Credit Management's core objective is to ensure that our business activities are conducted within a sound and prudent credit risk framework, aligned with the bank's risk appetite and regulatory requirements.
As a Credit Monitoring Officer, you will monitor credit exposures and risk developments across a range of business activities, helping to identify potential concerns at an early stage and ensuring that appropriate actions are taken.
This position requires a solid understanding of credit and risk principles, regulatory requirements, and analytical tools. You will contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of monitoring processes and supporting IT systems, while providing informed analyses and recommendations to management.

This role is offered on a one-year fixed-term contract until 31st August 2027.

Your responsibilities:

• Monitor credit exposures and risk developments across a range of business activities and escalate potential concerns where appropriate.
• Review counterparties' compliance with approved credit and collateral limits and investigate breaches.
• Monitor early warning indicators and support the identification of emerging risks and mitigation measures.
• Perform data analysis and data quality checks to support monitoring activities and decision-making.
• Prepare regular management and regulatory reporting in a timely and accurate manner.
• Assess the impact of new regulatory requirements and support their implementation.
• Contribute to the enhancement of monitoring processes, controls, and reporting frameworks.
• Support the development of business requirements, as well as the testing and implementation of system and tool enhancements.
• Maintain policies, procedures, governance documentation, and reporting inventories.

• Good understanding of financial instruments, market, credit, and risk management concepts. Knowledge of relevant regulations would be considered an asset.
• Strong analytical and investigative mindset, with the ability to identify issues, draw sound conclusions, and make practical recommendations.
• Comfortable working with data, conducting investigations, and following processes with a high degree of accuracy and consistency.
• Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a structured approach to managing recurring monitoring activities and competing priorities.
• Experience preparing reports and maintaining procedures, guidelines, or other governance documentation.
• Strong time management and prioritization skills, with the ability to remain reliable and accurate under pressure.

• Excellent command of written and spoken English; additional languages are considered an advantage.

·       collaborer avec les équipes internes, les agences et les partenaires externes afin de garantir la bonne réalisation des projets et campagnes.

Ce que nous attendons

·       Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français et l'anglais. La connaissance du luxembourgeois ou de l'allemand constitue un atout ;
·       Vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée en marketing digital, idéalement dans un environnement orienté acquisition et performance ;
·       Vous maîtrisez les principaux leviers du marketing digital : SEA, SEO, Social Ads, Display, analytics et conversion ;
·       Vous avez une expérience pratique de Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager et, idéalement, de Wizaly ;
·       Vous maîtrisez les enjeux liés au tracking, à l'attribution, à l'analyse de la performance et à l'optimisation des campagnes ;
·       Vous êtes à l'aise avec la création et l'optimisation de landing pages et de parcours de conversion ;
·       Vous connaissez les réseaux sociaux, la création de contenus et l'animation de communautés ;

À propos de Baloise

Nous sommes plus qu'une compagnie d'assurance traditionnelle : nous sommes le partenaire personnel de quiconque veut se sentir tout simplement en sécurité. Outre nos activités financières classiques, nous cherchons à innover et à créer des liens générateurs de valeur avec des partenariats et des start-ups. title: (Senior) Risk Manager (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
