title: Head of Geospatial AI - Foundation Models and Geo-Intelligence Platform
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland,  in areas such as natural hazards, agriculture, and forestry.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss national centre for supercomputing (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, agricultural organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Head of Geospatial AI, you will spearhead the Geo-Intelligence Team and own the development and implementation of ETH Swiss GeoLab’s geospatial AI, data and shared platform capabilities. With domain experts from academia and the tech industry, you will help define the technical strategy and architecture for multimodal foundation models, agentic AI systems, geospatial tools, data pipelines and compute infrastructure.

You will work closely with Research Program Support teams (plus the external partners mentioned above). You will lead cross-functional and external experts and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define and implement ETH Swiss GeoLab’s geospatial AI and technical strategy
Based on broad inputs, establish the target architecture for multimodal foundation models, agentic systems, geospatial data pipelines, compute environments and the shared Geo-Intelligence Platform
Adopt or set technical standards, priorities, interfaces and development principles aligned with GeoLab strategy and mission requirements
Drive and lead the design, development, evaluation and operationalisation of multimodal geospatial foundation models and related agentic capabilities
Encourage, enable or direct prototyping, benchmarking, validation and integration activities
Ensure that technical work produces reliable, reusable and operationally relevant capabilities rather than isolated research demonstrators
Own and be empowered to adapt the technical roadmap and delivery of the shared Geo-Intelligence Platform, including data access, processing pipelines, model-training environments, deployment capabilities and integration with HPC and cloud infrastructure
Coordinate with CSCS, ETH units, innovation leaders and technology providers to ensure scalability, security, efficiency and maintainability
Work with the Natural Hazards, Agriculture, Forestry and future Mission Leads to translate mission requirements into technical capabilities and delivery plans
Assess feasibility, define technical milestones, allocate technical resources and resolve trade-offs between mission-specific development and reusable platform components
Redirect technical work when evidence, performance or mission priorities require it
Lead or support technical collaborations with ETH groups, research institutions, CSCS, hyperscalers, companies, start-ups and open-source communities
Structure joint development activities, evaluate external capabilities and mobilise partners where they can accelerate delivery or provide distinctive expertise
In summary, you have a track record of innovative thought-leadership and a track record in brining others along with you on a journey for which the goal may not be 100% clear at the beginning. You are a voracious learner and are able to translate ambitious scientific and operational needs into robust, scalable and reusable technical solutions.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree in computer science, machine learning, geo-informatics, engineering, remote sensing or a related field
Several years of experience leading technical AI/ML, geospatial data or large-scale software and platform development activities that includes interactions with user communities
Demonstrated experience defining technical architectures, guiding interdisciplinary teams and managing technical resources such as platform architectures and large-scale data processing and ML workflows
Strong expertise in machine learning and multimodal foundation models with a track record of learning and adaptability as the industry and technological tools change. This also involves experience with agentic AI, reasoning systems or related AI architectures.
Excellent understanding of geospatial AI, Earth observation and remote sensing
Experience with HPC, cloud infrastructure or distributed computing environments
Proven ability to build reliable, reusable and operational technical capabilities in a cost-effective and agile manner
Experience working with academic, infrastructure, technology or industry partners
Excellent written and spoken English; German or French is an asset
You bring strong technical judgement and the ability to set direction under uncertainty. You have an excitement for technology and a passion to use this technology to enable breakthrough research and to change lives through the results it produces. You are a fast learner and a strong listener who also has the courage to try things and pivot where expectations are not fulfilled. You are able to lead highly qualified specialists, resolve architectural trade-offs and translate mission needs into scalable technical solutions. You are structured, delivery-oriented and willing to challenge or redirect weak approaches where needed. You communicate effectively across scientific, engineering, management and industry environments and build trust while maintaining clear standards, accountability and focus on outcomes.

A senior technical leadership role with high visibility and strategic relevance
The opportunity to develop geospatial AI capabilities with direct application to societal, environmental and economic challenges
The opportunity to build novel and useful AI, data and platform capabilities for multiple mission areas
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich

title: Softwareentwickler HMI
description:
Softwareentwickler HMI (m/w/d)

Gemeinsam mit 7\.300 Kolleg:innen an 49 Standorten in über 20 Ländern sind wir der strategische Lifecycle\-Partner der Pharma\-, Biotechnologie\- und Lebensmittelindustrie. Mit reibungslosen Prozessen, innovativen Technologien und nachhaltigen Lösungen helfen wir unseren Kunden, ihre Ziele zu erreichen. Wir sorgen zum Beispiel dafür, dass Impfstoffe sicher abgefüllt werden und Arzneimittel zuverlässig und gesetzeskonform produziert werden. title: Growth Marketer – E-Commerce
description:
Growth Marketer – E\-Commerce  
Location: Sonnentalstrasse 21, 8600 Dübendorf  
Work model: Hybrid – 4 days in the office  
Who we are  
Pflegewegweiser, part of the Entyre Group, is one of the fastest\-growing health\-tech scale\-ups in Switzerland and the US — 500\+ employees, locations from Zurich to Boston, and a mission that truly matters: helping people live independently at home. We make sure families are compensated for caring for their loved ones, and supply them with the homecare products they rely on every day.  
Pflegewegweiser Shop is a startup within this scale\-up. We're building an e\-commerce business from the ground up. That means: no legacy accounts to inherit, no 40\-page media plans, and no waiting three quarters for your test to go live. You launch it, you own it, you read and interpret the numbers, and you act accordingly.  
What you'll own  
The paid engine. You own Google Search, Shopping, and PMax end\-to\-end — from campaigns to assets to budget. You run the Merchant Center and the shopping feed like they're yours — because they are: clean data, healthy diagnostics, well\-maintained feeds.  
Meta \& creatives. You plan, launch, and optimize our Meta campaigns. You drive the creatives that feed them — static and video — from in\-house production to briefing and directing agencies. You know a winning ad isn't luck, it's a testing pipeline.  
Funnels. You build marketing funnels across the entire customer journey and continuously optimize them — from first click to repeat purchase.  
Growth sprints. You design experiments that open up new growth opportunities beyond day\-to\-day optimization. You find the growth opportunities we haven't identified or tapped yet.  
New bets. You develop new business models together with the Head of E\-Commerce, stress\-test them, and make them better — expanding what the shop can be.  
The setup. You question existing setups and processes, iterate on them, and make them better. If something is slow, manual, or "just grew that way," you challenge it.  
The shop. You help improve the shop experience, drive e\-commerce sales, and elevate the customer experience — your insights and improvement suggestions can be implemented quickly and directly to give our customers a better experience.  
The numbers. You analyze marketing and sales KPIs to find growth opportunities and efficiencies. Your analysis doesn't just go into a report — it directly influences our spending and budget allocations.  
What you bring  
2–5 years of marketing experience, preferably at a startup, scale\-up, or agency  
Hands\-on experience with paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta — you've set up and optimized campaigns yourself, not just watched a dashboard  
A data\-driven understanding of marketing and e\-commerce KPIs — comfortable with reporting and able to move quickly from raw data to an actionable recommendation  
Ownership from day one — you'd rather build the process than wait for one  
Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy balance between speed and quality  
German and English \- both C1\+  
Nice to have  
Experience with Google Merchant Center and shopping feeds  
Familiarity with Shopify or a comparable e\-commerce platform  
Basic creative skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, video production) and experience briefing creative agencies  
Knowledge of A/B testing, CRO, and funnel analytics  
An affinity for healthcare/homecare — or the curiosity to dive deep  
Why this role  
0 to 1, for real. You build the growth engine instead of waiting for someone else to.  
Direct line to leadership. You report to the Senior Growth Manager and work closely with the Chief Business Development Officer. Short paths, fast decisions, no bureaucracy. You learn fast, get direct feedback, and quickly gain ownership of your own topics and areas of responsibility.  
Impact you can see. Small, independent team; your tests land in the business immediately.  
Scale at your back. The pace and autonomy of a startup, backed by the resources of an international group — in one of the biggest growth markets there is: homecare and digital health.  
How we operate — non\-negotiable:  
"Insanely great" for families — delivered now  
Forget mere "satisfaction." We deliver support that makes caregivers feel seen, understood, and valued. Anticipate their needs and solve problems quickly. The standard is "insanely great," period. Anything less slows us down and fails our families.  
Speed is king — ruthless focus is key  
Velocity comes from focus. Eliminate distractions. Concentrate all effort on the \#1 critical objective until it's done, then move to the next. Decide what not to do and cut it ruthlessly. Being a mile wide and an inch deep is failure — move the needle now.  
Raise the bar — crush mediocrity  
Mediocrity kills speed, morale, and companies. Hunt it down and eliminate it. Good enough is never good enough. Demand top performance from yourself and everyone around you. Own your work, deliver excellence fast, and accept no excuses.  
The speed algorithm — question, delete, simplify, accelerate  
Build momentum by questioning every requirement: who asked, and why? Delete ruthlessly — parts, processes, bureaucracy. Simplify what remains. Accelerate cycle times relentlessly. "It can't be done" means "you haven't figured it out yet — go do it." Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.  
Act like owners — bold bets, fast action  
This is your company. Own the mission and the results. Take initiative, make bold bets that leapfrog progress, and act decisively. If you stumble, learn faster and go again. Bias for action is everything.  
The bottom line:  
We are building something vital at lightning speed. This requires intensity, focus, and a relentless drive to execute. If reading this makes you want to jump in and build faster, welcome to Pflegewegweiser!

Deutsch:  
Wer wir sind  
Pflegewegweiser, Teil der Entyre Group, ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Health\-Tech\-Scale\-ups in der Schweiz und den USA – 500\+ Mitarbeitende, Standorte von Zürich bis Boston und eine Mission, die wirklich zählt: Menschen zu helfen, selbstbestimmt zu Hause zu leben. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Familien für die Pflege ihrer Angehörigen entschädigt werden, und beliefern sie mit den Homecare\-Produkten, auf die sie sich täglich verlassen.  
Der Pflegewegweiser Shop ist ein Startup innerhalb dieses Scale\-ups. Wir bauen ein E\-Commerce\-Business von null auf. Das heisst: keine Alt\-Accounts, die du erbst, keine 40\-seitigen Mediapläne und kein Warten über drei Quartale, bis dein Test live geht. Du launchst es, du ownst es, du liest und interpretierst die Zahlen, und handelst entsprechend.  
Was du ownst  
Die Paid\-Engine. Du ownst Google Search, Shopping und PMax end\-to\-end – von Kampagnen über Assets bis Budget. Du führst das Merchant Center und den Shopping\-Feed, als wären sie deine – denn das sind sie: saubere Daten, gesunde Diagnostics, top gepflegte Feeds.

Growth Sprints. Du designst Experimente, die neue Wachstumschancen jenseits der täglichen Optimierungen ermöglichen. Du findest die Wachstumsmöglichkeiten, die wir noch nicht kennen und erschlossen haben.  
Neue Bets. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of E\-Commerce neue Geschäftsmodelle, prüfst sie auf Herz und Nieren und machst sie besser – und erweiterst so, was der Shop sein kann.  
Das Setup. Du hinterfragst bestehende Setups und Prozesse, iterierst sie und machst sie besser. Ist etwas langsam, manuell oder «einfach so gewachsen», stellst du es infrage.  
Der Shop. Du hilfst mit, die Shop\-Experience zu verbessern, E\-Commerce\-Sales zu treiben und die Customer Experience auf ein neues Level zu heben – deine Insights und Verbesserungsvorschläge können und direkt umgesetzt werden, um unseren Kunden eine bessere Customer Experience zu ermöglichen.  
Die Zahlen. Du analysierst Marketing\- und Sales\-KPIs, um Wachstumschancen und Effizienzen zu finden. Deine Analyse geht nicht nur in einen Report – sie hat einen direkten Einfluss auf unser Spending und Budget Allocations.  
Was du mitbringst  
1–2 Jahre Marketing\-Erfahrung, bevorzugt in Start\-ups, Scale\-ups oder Agentur  
Hands\-on\-Erfahrung mit Paid\-Kampagnen auf Google Ads und Meta – du hast selbst Kampagnen aufgesetzt und optimiert, nicht nur ein Dashboard beobachtet  
Ein datengetriebenes Verständnis von Marketing\- und E\-Commerce\-KPIs – fit in Reportings und in der Lage, von Rohdaten zu einer belastbaren Empfehlung zu kommen  
Ownership ab Tag eins – du baust lieber den Prozess, als auf einen zu warten  
Einen Umgang mit Ambiguität und eine gesunde Balance zwischen Speed und Qualität  
C1\+ Deutsch und Englisch  
Pluspunkte  
Erfahrung mit Google Merchant Center und Shopping\-Feeds  
Vertrautheit mit Shopify oder einer vergleichbaren E\-Commerce\-Plattform  
Basic Creative\-Skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, Video Production) und Erfahrung im Briefen von Kreativagenturen  
Kenntnisse in A/B\-Testing, CRO und Funnel\-Analytik  
Eine Affinität zu Healthcare/Homecare – oder die Neugier, tief einzutauchen  
Warum dieser Platz  
0\-to\-1, wirklich. Du baust die Growth\-Engine, anstatt auf andere zu warten.

Research Fundraiser (m/f/d) 80% \- 100%  
Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.  
Eawag is currently developing its institutional fundraising activities to strengthen support for research, infrastructure, and strategic initiatives. To drive these efforts and foster meaningful engagement with philanthropic and funding partners, we are looking for a dedicated  
Research Fundraiser (m/f/d) 80% \- 100%  
Would you like to help shape the fundraising activities of an internationally renowned environmental research institute? As part of the ETH Domain, Eawag offers a unique opportunity to build and further develop institutional fundraising in a collaborative and purpose\-driven environment. You will identify suitable funding opportunities and develop sustainable funding partnerships with foundations, institutional funding organisations, philanthropic partners and selected major donors. Working closely with researchers, the Directorate and the Communications team, you will develop compelling funding concepts that communicate Eawag's scientific strengths and strategic objectives in a clear and attractive way to funding partners  
This position offers you a high degree of responsibility and autonomy, as well as the opportunity to actively shape Eawag's fundraising activities and strategic partnerships.  
Your responsibilities  
Conduct research, analysis and identification of potential funding partners, in particular foundations and private major donors.  
Assess and evaluate research projects regarding their fundraising potential.  
Work closely with researchers to develop audience\-specific fundraising materials, such as funding cases, project proposals and progress reports.  
Build and maintain long\-term relationships with funding partners and donors, support the acquisition of new partners and manage funding partnerships throughout the entire funding cycle.  
Manage administrative fundraising processes, including contract management, payment processing and maintenance of data in the CRM system.  
In close collaboration with the Communications team, plan and coordinate visits and events for existing and potential funding partners and develop fundraising\-specific content for Eawag's communication channels.  
Your qualifications  
At least five years of professional experience in fundraising, ideally in foundation fundraising, institutional fundraising or major donor fundraising.  
Proven track record in developing successful funding proposals as well as establishing and maintaining long\-term funding partnerships.  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, combined with a strong service\-oriented mindset. You build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders and collaborate effectively with different research groups.  
A structured and independent working style, with strong organisational skills.  
A strong interest in scientific topics, particularly environmental research; experience in research, higher education, environmental sustainability or healthcare is an advantage.  
Confident use of common digital tools, including CRM systems.  
You have excellent command of German or French and good knowledge of the other language. You are fluent in English at a professional level and able to communicate and negotiate confidently.  
At Eawag, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.  
Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it \- we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information please visit our website about Eawag as well as our conditions of employment.  
Applications must be submitted by September 15th, 2026, or until the position is filled. However, screening of applicants will begin immediately. Your application should include a cover letter giving a description of the motivation to apply and highlighting the relevant experience, curriculum vitae, and the names (with email addresses and phone numbers) of at least two potential references  
For further information, please contact , Deputy Director, via email.

title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Principal Process Chemist Specialist

description:
At Syngenta Group, we're a global community of 56,000 innovators across 90 countries, united by a 250-year legacy of agricultural excellence. As the world's most local agricultural technology partner, we create tailor-made solutions that transform farming while protecting our planet, driven by our commitment to innovation, ethics, and integrity. Through our inclusive environment and diverse perspectives, we pioneer breakthrough solutions for farmers, society, and future generations. Join our worldwide teams of agricultural pioneers in creating a more resilient and equitable food system for all.

Job Description

Purpose
•    Provide technical leadership for a particular product or capability within the Process Technology (PT) environment, holding the chemistry and process know-how for assigned chemical steps.
•    Lead the local technical team in the development, introduction, and support of chemical processes for new and mature intermediates and/or active substances, in close collaboration with WMU and Global Process Technology.
•    Drive improvement plans for chemical processes to increase capacity, improve quality, and reduce costs, while troubleshooting process issues (leading cost and process learning curves).
•    Support process relocation projects to external suppliers or other manufacturing sites, and coach junior chemists.

Accountabilities

General & HSE:
•    Ensure that the manufacturing process is safe and compliant with legal and internal HSE rules at all times.
•    Ensure process design meets the requirements of company and national HSEQ and regulatory standards (e.g., Chemical Reaction Hazards, PRA, Management of Change).
•    Define, plan, and control laboratory work, semi-technical, and full-scale plant trials to develop and test new or improved manufacturing processes.
•    Lead programs of scientific work, defining individual tasks and technical designs within complex, challenging projects.
•    Store project data electronically and compile technical reports to record and share experimental results.
•    Actively participate in local and global technical networks to share knowledge and stay connected with other Syngenta sites (CHMU, GBJH, etc.).
Production Support:
•    Define key process parameters and design control strategies to ensure they remain within safe and optimal limits.
•    Provide proactive technical support and troubleshooting to manufacturing plants to restore or improve production performance.
•    Deliver technological recommendations to improve plant capacity, production costs, waste reduction, and energy consumption.
Supply Chain & Project Support:
•    Understand supply chain requirements and take a leading role in delivering objectives (acting as the Technology Lead for specific Active Ingredients (AIs) when required).
•    Lead the technical transfer of manufacturing processes to third parties (outsourcing) or other Syngenta facilities in coordination with the Technology & Sourcing Manager.
•    Provide process chemistry expertise to supply chain and project teams, collaborating closely with Process Engineers.
•    Participate in the commissioning of new or modified plants as part of technical start-up teams.

Qualifications

•    Education: MSc or ideally a PhD in Chemistry, typically with post-doctoral experience.
•    Experience: Minimum of 3 years of industrial experience, ideally with NAIS and AIP knowledge.
•    Technical Expertise: Strong background in synthetic organic chemistry and good knowledge of industrial-scale manufacturing processes.
•    Process Safety: Solid understanding of process safety, reaction hazards, electrostatics, and environmental issues.
•    Change Management: Detailed knowledge of systems for process change and their potential implications on product quality (formulation, regulatory, etc.).
•    Business Acumen: Awareness of costing systems and the financial impact of PT development work on Supply Chain performance.
•    Leadership & Collaboration: Proven ability to work autonomously, lead complex technical projects, and coach/train junior colleagues.

What We Offer

•    A competitive salary
•    Career opportunities as well as possibilities for individual development and continuous training
•    Special attention to your work-life balance with flexible working conditions and flexible hours
•    A work environment that promotes agility, diversity, and teamwork
•    Responsible and varied work in a forward-thinking company
•    On-site company restaurant

Pflegewegweiser, part of the Entyre Group, is one of the fastest\-growing health\-tech scale\-ups in Switzerland and the US — 500\+ employees, locations from Zurich to Boston, and a mission that truly matters: helping people live independently at home. We make sure families are compensated for caring for their loved ones, and supply them with the homecare products they rely on every day.  
Pflegewegweiser Shop is a startup within this scale\-up. We're building an e\-commerce business from the ground up. That means: no legacy accounts to inherit, no 40\-page media plans, and no waiting three quarters for your test to go live. You launch it, you own it, you read and interpret the numbers, and you act accordingly.  
What you'll own  
The paid engine. You own Google Search, Shopping, and PMax end\-to\-end — from campaigns to assets to budget. You run the Merchant Center and the shopping feed like they're yours — because they are: clean data, healthy diagnostics, well\-maintained feeds.  
Meta \& creatives. You plan, launch, and optimize our Meta campaigns. You drive the creatives that feed them — static and video — from in\-house production to briefing and directing agencies. You know a winning ad isn't luck, it's a testing pipeline.  
Funnels. You build marketing funnels across the entire customer journey and continuously optimize them — from first click to repeat purchase.  
Growth sprints. You design experiments that open up new growth opportunities beyond day\-to\-day optimization. You find the growth opportunities we haven't identified or tapped yet.  
New bets. You develop new business models together with the Head of E\-Commerce, stress\-test them, and make them better — expanding what the shop can be.  
The setup. You question existing setups and processes, iterate on them, and make them better. If something is slow, manual, or "just grew that way," you challenge it.  
The shop. You help improve the shop experience, drive e\-commerce sales, and elevate the customer experience — your insights and improvement suggestions can be implemented quickly and directly to give our customers a better experience.  
The numbers. You analyze marketing and sales KPIs to find growth opportunities and efficiencies. Your analysis doesn't just go into a report — it directly influences our spending and budget allocations.  
What you bring  
2–5 years of marketing experience, preferably at a startup, scale\-up, or agency  
Hands\-on experience with paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta — you've set up and optimized campaigns yourself, not just watched a dashboard  
A data\-driven understanding of marketing and e\-commerce KPIs — comfortable with reporting and able to move quickly from raw data to an actionable recommendation  
Ownership from day one — you'd rather build the process than wait for one  
Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy balance between speed and quality  
German and English \- both C1\+  
Nice to have  
Experience with Google Merchant Center and shopping feeds  
Familiarity with Shopify or a comparable e\-commerce platform  
Basic creative skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, video production) and experience briefing creative agencies  
Knowledge of A/B testing, CRO, and funnel analytics  
An affinity for healthcare/homecare — or the curiosity to dive deep  
Why this role  
0 to 1, for real. You build the growth engine instead of waiting for someone else to.  
Direct line to leadership. You report to the Senior Growth Manager and work closely with the Chief Business Development Officer. Short paths, fast decisions, no bureaucracy. You learn fast, get direct feedback, and quickly gain ownership of your own topics and areas of responsibility.  
Impact you can see. Small, independent team; your tests land in the business immediately.  
Scale at your back. The pace and autonomy of a startup, backed by the resources of an international group — in one of the biggest growth markets there is: homecare and digital health.  
How we operate — non\-negotiable:  
"Insanely great" for families — delivered now  
Forget mere "satisfaction." We deliver support that makes caregivers feel seen, understood, and valued. Anticipate their needs and solve problems quickly. The standard is "insanely great," period. Anything less slows us down and fails our families.  
Speed is king — ruthless focus is key  
Velocity comes from focus. Eliminate distractions. Concentrate all effort on the \#1 critical objective until it's done, then move to the next. Decide what not to do and cut it ruthlessly. Being a mile wide and an inch deep is failure — move the needle now.  
Raise the bar — crush mediocrity  
Mediocrity kills speed, morale, and companies. Hunt it down and eliminate it. Good enough is never good enough. Demand top performance from yourself and everyone around you. Own your work, deliver excellence fast, and accept no excuses.  
The speed algorithm — question, delete, simplify, accelerate  
Build momentum by questioning every requirement: who asked, and why? Delete ruthlessly — parts, processes, bureaucracy. Simplify what remains. Accelerate cycle times relentlessly. "It can't be done" means "you haven't figured it out yet — go do it." Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.  
Act like owners — bold bets, fast action  
This is your company. Own the mission and the results. Take initiative, make bold bets that leapfrog progress, and act decisively. If you stumble, learn faster and go again. Bias for action is everything.  
The bottom line:  
We are building something vital at lightning speed. This requires intensity, focus, and a relentless drive to execute. If reading this makes you want to jump in and build faster, welcome to Pflegewegweiser!

Wir sorgen dafür, dass Familien für die Pflege ihrer Angehörigen entschädigt werden, und beliefern sie mit den Homecare\-Produkten, auf die sie sich täglich verlassen.

Neue Bets. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of E\-Commerce neue Geschäftsmodelle, prüfst sie auf Herz und Nieren und machst sie besser – und erweiterst so, was der Shop sein kann.

title: Disponent:in in der Einsatzleitstelle 100%
description:
Disponent:in in der Einsatzleitstelle 100%  
Die DB Cargo AG ist die Güterverkehrstochter der Deutschen Bahn AG. Als europäischer Marktführer im Schienengüterverkehr verfolgen wir konsequent den internationalen Ausbau unseres Netzwerkes. Unsere Dienstleistungen erbringen wir heute mit eigenen Tochtergesellschaften in ganz Europa. Die DB Cargo Schweiz GmbH mit Sitz in Glattbrugg ist Teil dieses Verbundes und trägt so zum weiteren qualitativen und quantitativen Wachstum des Netzwerkes bei.  
Disponent:in in der Einsatzleitstelle 100%  
In dieser spannenden Position erwarten dich folgende Tätigkeiten:  
Verantwortlich für das Sicherstellen der Einhaltung der abgegebenen Kundenversprechen im operativen Eisenbahnbetrieb  
Proaktives Überwachen der Züge sowie kunden\-, sicherheits\- und betriebsorientiertes Eingreifen bei Abweichungen  
Verantwortlich für die Sicherstellung der Erreichbarkeit und Durchführung der Verkehre rund um die Uhr (24/7 Schichtbetrieb)  
Dreh\- und Angelpunkt im Austausch von Informationen und Daten zwischen verschiedenen Akteuren (Kunden, Partnerbahnen, etc.)  
Einhaltung der Arbeitszeitregelungen und \-gesetze des eingesetzten Betriebspersonals  
Gewährleisten der Qualität in der Durchführung der Transporte im europäischen Netzwerk unter Berücksichtigung der geltenden Regelwerke  
Diese Anforderungen solltest du mitbringen:  
Du hast eine bahnbetriebliche Berufserfahrung und möchtest dich im Bereich Disposition weiterentwickeln  
Zudem empfindest du verschiedene Problemstellungen im täglichen Bahnbetrieb als eine spannende Herausforderung  
Im Weiteren abreitest du zuverlässig, vernetzt und hast den Blick fürs Ganze, ohne die Details aus den Augen zu verlieren  
Du verfügst neben Deutsch über gute Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch (zwingend) und Italienisch (wünschenswert)  
Generalabonnement (GA) öV Schweiz, Langzeitkonto, Lunch\-Checks, Mind. 5 Wochen Ferien  
DB Cargo Schweiz is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy. jpid5b01b96jm jit0833jm jiy26jm

title: Legal Counsel
description:
Legal Counsel

Legal Counsel

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded lawyer who enjoys working in a dynamic international environment and partnering closely with business stakeholders to support strategic projects and day\-to\-day operations.  
Missions:  
Provide practical legal advice on corporate, commercial, governance, and operational matters.  
Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of commercial and corporate agreements.  
Support legal and regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions.  
Assist with corporate governance activities, including company incorporations, statutory filings, and corporate records management.  
Advise on contract administration, claims management, and contractual risk allocation.  
Support strategic projects and provide pragmatic legal solutions aligned with business objectives.

Working knowledge of FIDIC contracts, variation order management, and contract administration principles.  
Exposure to arbitration and dispute resolution matters.  
Experience supporting corporate governance and entity management activities.  
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.  
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced international environment.  
Proficiency with legal technology and AI\-powered tools is an advantage.  
What We Offer  
A varied and challenging legal role within a rapidly growing international organization.  
Exposure to complex cross\-border projects and strategic business initiatives.  
A collaborative and entrepreneurial working environment.  
Opportunities for professional growth and development.

title: Conducteur de Travaux - Rénovation & Transformation
description:
Conducteur de Travaux \- Rénovation \& Transformation  
Conducteur de Travaux \- Rénovation \& Transformation  
Description de l'entreprise  
Notre client est un acteur établi du secteur de la construction en Suisse romande. Grâce à son expertise technique, à ses équipes expérimentées et à sa capacité à mener des projets complexes, l'entreprise intervient sur des chantiers variés de rénovation, de transformation et de réhabilitation de bâtiments. Elle propose un environnement dynamique, axé sur la qualité, la sécurité et l'efficacité opérationnelle, au sein duquel chaque collaborateur bénéficie d'un réel niveau d'autonomie et de responsabilités.  
Description du poste  
Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous serez responsable de la préparation, de l'organisation et du suivi complet de vos chantiers de rénovation et de transformation, de la phase de préparation jusqu'à leur réalisation finale.  
Préparer les chantiers sur les plans technique, organisationnel et financier.  
Analyser les plans, les dossiers d'exécution et les spécificités liées aux bâtiments existants.  
Planifier les différentes étapes des travaux, notamment les besoins en personnel, en matériel et en équipements.  
Organiser le déroulement quotidien des chantiers et assurer leur exécution opérationnelle.  
Coordonner les équipes, les sous\-traitants et les différents corps de métier.  
Assurer la commande, l'approvisionnement et la disponibilité des matériaux nécessaires.  
Anticiper les éventuelles contraintes liées à l'occupation, à l'exploitation ou à la structure des bâtiments existants.  
Mettre en place et suivre les procédures liées à la qualité, à la sécurité et à l'environnement.  
Contrôler l'avancement des travaux ainsi que le respect des délais, des coûts et des exigences techniques.  
Assurer le suivi financier des chantiers.  
Élaborer les offres, les offres complémentaires et les métrés des travaux réalisés.  
Participer à la facturation et au contrôle des prestations exécutées.  
Participer aux séances de chantier et assurer le suivi des décisions prises.  
Entretenir une relation professionnelle de qualité avec les maîtres d'ouvrage, les directions de travaux, les mandataires et les partenaires du projet.  
Profil recherché  
Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation reconnue de conducteur(trice) de travaux.  
Vous justifiez d'au moins cinq ans d'expérience confirmée dans la conduite de chantiers en Suisse.  
Vous disposez d'une expérience concrète dans le domaine de la rénovation et de la transformation.  
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels ainsi que le logiciel BauBit.  
Vous êtes à l'aise dans le suivi technique, administratif et financier des chantiers.  
Vous êtes une personne proactive, autonome, organisée et dotée d'un bon sens des responsabilités.  
Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez communiquer efficacement avec les différents intervenants d'un chantier.  
Vous êtes capable de gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement exigeant et en constante évolution.

title: Assistant en soins et santé communautaire
description:
Assistant en soins et santé communautaire (H/F)  
Nos centres Médico\-Sociaux (CMS) offrent à la population Lausannoise des prestations pluridisciplinaires de qualité et leurs interventions reposent sur des valeurs d’humanité et d’équité.  
En rejoignant la Fondation Soins Lausanne, vous vous engagez de ère concrète en faveur de la santé et du bien\-vivre dans le canton de Vaud, au sein d’équipes expertes, motivées et enthousiastes, dans une activité variée et riche en contacts humains.  
Sur le terrain, vous intervenez sur le lieu de vie ou d’activité des bénéficiaires. Vous définissez avec les clients les solutions les plus adaptées à leurs situations et développez ainsi une connaissance fine et une relation de confiance privilégiée avec eux. Faisant partie d’une équipe soudée et soutenante, l’exercice de ces métiers permet une grande autonomie mais nécessite de grandes responsabilités et une flexibilité de la part de nos collaborateurs.  
Afin de compléter nos équipes, les CMS de la Fondation Soins Lausanne recherche de suite ou à convenir un/e:  
Assistant en soins et santé communautaire (H/F)  
Taux d'activité entre 60% et 80%  
Contrat fixe à durée indeterminée  
Votre mission  
Dispenser des soins médico\-techniques délégués et de soins de base en collaboration étroite avec un.e infirmier.ère pour une prise en charge de qualité des clients  
Contribuer activement au maintien à domicile des clients par des mesures de prévention et de promotion de la santé tout en tenant compte des besoins individuels avec une prise en charge personnalisée et en favorisant l’autonomie des clients  
Participer à l’élaboration du projet thérapeutique des clients au sein de l’équipe interdisciplinaire en récoltant et en transmettant vos observations et propositions  
Participer à des projets de développement et aux groupes de travail autour de l’amélioration continue des prestations dans le domaine des aides et soins à domicile  
Collaborer activement aux activités des équipes interdisciplinaires avec un rôle propre vous permettant de valoriser votre métier d’ASSC comme partie prenante à part entière du système de santé  
Votre pofil et vos compétences  
CFC d'ASSC ou titre jugé équivalent (diplôme étranger reconnu par la CRS)  
Expérience dans le domaine médico\-social et intérêt marqué pour la santé communautaire  
Capacité à collaborer en réseau et en pluridisciplinarité  
Sens des responsabilités et éthique professionnelle  
Nous offrons  
Un cadre de travail stimulant et chaleureux où l'autonomie du soignant est mise en avant  
Un environnement de travail qui privilègie le contact humain et l'échange  
Un travail passionnant dans un cadre agréable pour le bien\-être des clients  
Des conditions de travail et de rémunération équitables  
Des conditions de prévoyance professionnelle qui s’étendent au\-delà des prestations minimales prévues par la loi  
Les avantages de nous rejoindre  
Plan d’intégration par métier, offres de formations continues riches et variées, possibilités d’évolution professionnelle  
L'équité salariale entre femmes et hommes (certification Fair\-ON\-Pay)  
Rémunération selon la Convention Collective de Travail (CCT) du secteur sanitaire parapublic vaudois  
Offres avantageuses avec tarifs préférentiels dans des sociétés de services autour du sport, santé et bien\-être et loisirs divers  
Politique de mobilité douce et participation aux frais de transports publics  
Cinq semaines de vacances par année et six semaines dès 50 ans  
Pour un traitement de qualité de votre candidature, nous vous prions d'adresser un dossier de candidature complet en précisant le taux d'activité souhaité via Jobup jusqu'au 25 août 2026\. Le service des Resources Humaines se fera un plaisir de vous répondre dans les meilleurs délais. jpid1d63301jm jit0833jm jiy26jm

title: Ergothérapeute
description:
Ergothérapeute (H/F)  
Nos centres Médico\-Sociaux (CMS) offrent à la population Lausannoise des prestations pluridisciplinaires de qualité et leurs interventions reposent sur des valeurs d’humanité et d’équité.  
En rejoignant la Fondation Soins Lausanne, vous vous engagez de ère concrète en faveur de la santé et du bien\-vivre dans le canton de Vaud, au sein d’équipes expertes, motivées et enthousiastes, dans une activité variée et riche en contacts humains.  
Sur le terrain, vous intervenez sur le lieu de vie ou d’activité des bénéficiaires. Vous définissez avec les clients les solutions les plus adaptées à leurs situations et développez ainsi une connaissance fine et une relation de confiance privilégiée avec eux. Faisant partie d’une équipe soudée et soutenante, l’exercice de ces métiers permet une grande autonomie mais nécessite de grandes responsabilités et une flexibilité de la part de nos collaborateurs.  
Afin de compléter nos équipes, les CMS de la Fondation Soins Lausanne recherche de suite ou à convenir plusieurs :  
Ergothérapeute (H/F)  
Taux d'activité entre 80% et 100%  
Contrat fixe à durée indeterminée  
Votre mission  
Évaluer les besoins du client et de son entourage, ainsi que son niveau d’indépendance pour la réalisation des activités quotidiennes et établir un bilan des capacités fonctionnelles tout en se basant sur les ressources à disposition  
Rétablir des conditions qui permettent aux clients de réaliser les activités de la vie courante en toute indépendance, en proposant des moyens auxiliaires et des aménagements de l’environnement de vie et leur profil occupationnel  
Accompagner les clients dans le développement de nouvelles aptitudes physiques, psychiques et sociales. Contribuer activement au maintien à domicile des clients par des mesures de prévention et de promotion de la santé tout en tenant compte des besoins individuels avec une prise en charge personnalisée et en favorisant l’autonomie des clients  
Participer à l’élaboration du projet thérapeutique des clients au sein de l’équipe interdisciplinaire  
Participer à des projets de développement et aux groupes de travail autour de l’amélioration continue des prestations dans le domaine des aides et soins à domicile  
Collaborer activement aux activités des équipes interdisciplinaires avec un rôle propre vous permettant de valoriser votre métier d’ergothérapeute comme partie prenante à part entière du système de santé  
Votre profil et vos compétences  
Bachelor en ergothérapie ou titre jugé équivalent (diplôme étranger reconnu par la CRS)  
Expérience en service hospitalier de soins physiques ou de psychiatrie, service de rééducation, soins à domicile ou cabinet privé un atout  
Intérêt marqué pour la santé communautaire  
Capacité à collaborer en réseau et en pluridisciplinarité  
Sens des responsabilités, capacité à s'organiser de ère autonome et à fixer des priorités  
Nous offrons  
Un cadre de travail stimulant et chaleureux où l'autonomie du soignant est mise en avant  
Un environnement de travail qui privilègie le contact humain et l'échange  
Un travail passionnant dans un cadre agréable pour le bien\-être des clients  
Des conditions de travail et de rémunération équitables  
Des conditions de prévoyance professionnelle qui s’étendent au\-delà des prestations minimales prévues par la loi  
La flexibilité des horaires de travail et du taux d'activité  
Les avantages de nous rejoindre  
Plan d’intégration par métier, offres de formations continues riches et variées, possibilités d’évolution professionnelle  
L'équité salariale entre femmes et hommes (certification Fair\-ON\-Pay)  
Rémunération selon la Convention Collective de Travail (CCT) du secteur sanitaire parapublic vaudois

title: Conducteur de Travaux - Terrassement
description:
Conducteur de Travaux \- Terrassement  
Conducteur de Travaux \- Terrassement  
Description de l'entreprise  
Notre client est un acteur établi du secteur de la construction en Suisse romande. Grâce à son expertise technique, à ses équipes expérimentées et à sa capacité à réaliser des projets d'envergure, l'entreprise intervient sur des chantiers variés dans le domaine du terrassement et des infrastructures. Elle propose un environnement dynamique, axé sur la qualité, la sécurité et l'efficacité opérationnelle, au sein duquel chaque collaborateur bénéficie d'un réel niveau d'autonomie et de responsabilités.  
Description du poste  
Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous serez responsable de la préparation, de l'organisation et du suivi complet de vos chantiers de terrassement, de la phase de préparation jusqu'à leur réalisation finale.  
Préparer les chantiers sur les plans technique, organisationnel et financier.  
Planifier les différentes étapes des travaux, notamment les besoins en personnel, en matériel et en équipements.  
Organiser le déroulement quotidien des chantiers et assurer leur exécution opérationnelle.  
Coordonner les équipes, les sous\-traitants et les différents intervenants.  
Assurer la commande, l'approvisionnement et la disponibilité des matériaux et équipements nécessaires.  
Mettre en place et suivre les procédures liées à la qualité, à la sécurité et à l'environnement.  
Contrôler l'avancement des travaux ainsi que le respect des délais et des coûts.  
Assurer le suivi financier des chantiers.  
Élaborer les offres, les offres complémentaires et les métrés des travaux réalisés.  
Participer à la facturation et au contrôle des prestations exécutées.  
Participer aux séances de chantier et assurer le suivi des décisions prises.  
Entretenir une relation professionnelle de qualité avec les maîtres d'ouvrage, les directions de travaux et les partenaires du projet.  
Profil recherché  
Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation reconnue de conducteur(trice) de travaux.  
Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience confirmée dans la conduite de chantiers en Suisse.  
Vous disposez d'une expérience concrète dans le domaine du terrassement.  
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels ainsi que le logiciel BauBit.  
Vous êtes à l'aise dans le suivi technique, administratif et financier des chantiers.  
Vous êtes une personne proactive, autonome, organisée et dotée d'un bon sens des responsabilités.  
Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez communiquer efficacement avec les différents intervenants d'un chantier.

Eine Ikone der Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.  
Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.  
Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.

title: Executive Assistant & Private PA to the Chairman & CEO
description:
Executive Assistant \& Private PA to the Chairman \& CEO  
About the Company  
A privately owned investment holding based in Zurich. Through its operating companies, it develops strategic resources at origin, alongside proprietary investments in emerging technologies.  
The Zurich team is small and senior, with short decision paths — this role has direct visibility and impact.  
We are looking for an organized, responsible, and proactive assistant who combines classic executive assistance to our Chairman \& CEO with corporate and office support for the Zurich team — and, distinctively, with private and family support for the principal. This is a true right\-hand role spanning both the professional and private spheres, suited to someone who enjoys variety, takes genuine ownership, and treats discretion as second nature.  
Key Responsibilities  
Executive Assistance to the CEO  
Book and manage international travel (flights, hotels, visas), both European and global  
Proactively manage the CEO's calendar across time zones, anticipating conflicts and protecting focus time  
Prepare meeting briefings, agendas, and follow\-ups; track action items to completion  
Track and process expenses per the group's expense policy  
Act as first point of contact for the CEO's calendar and correspondence, exercising sound judgment on prioritization and access  
Corporate \& Governance Support  
Support board meeting logistics (scheduling, board packs, resolutions)  
Maintain document retention and archiving across group entities  
Track statutory and filing deadlines  
Liaise with external providers (fiduciary, insurance broker, external counsel, banks) on administrative matters  
Private \& Family Support  
Schedule and track personal appointments for the principal and family (medical, dental, and similar), including reminders and follow\-ups  
Coordinate children's school administration and communications, extracurricular activities, and related logistics — largely in German  
Plan and book private and family travel and holidays  
Handle household administration: insurance policies, vehicle matters (registration, servicing, appointments), property\-related paperwork, and coordination of contractors and service providers  
Manage personal errands, purchases, gifting, and restaurant and event reservations  
Serve as a reliable point of coordination between the office, the household, and the family  
Office Management \& Cross\-Jurisdictional Coordination  
Support day\-to\-day operations of the Zurich office (supplies, facilities, visitors, mail)  
Assist with administrative coordination across the group's international entities  
Candidate Profile  
Required  
Experience as a Personal/Executive Assistant, Private PA, or in a comparable role supporting senior leadership, a principal, or a family  
Fluent English and German (written and spoken) — German is essential for schools, medical providers, and Swiss administration  
Experience organizing complex international travel  
High discretion; able to handle confidential legal, HR, financial, family, and household information responsibly  
Comfortable working closely with a family as well as an executive team, and able to move naturally between the two  
Proactive, hands\-on, solutions\-oriented; comfortable in a small, lean team without heavy bureaucracy  
Strong MS Office skills; comfortable learning new tools  
Valid Swiss work permit or EU/EFTA citizenship  
Advantageous  
Prior experience in a family office, private household, or entrepreneur\-led environment  
Familiarity with the Swiss school system and local administrative processes  
Additional languages (e.g., French)  
Working Arrangements  
This is an on\-site role based in central Zurich during normal office hours. Given the private\-support dimension, occasional flexibility outside standard hours is expected for time\-sensitive personal or travel matters; this is managed reasonably and reciprocated with flexibility in return.  
What We Offer  
Direct, daily exposure to the Chairman/CEO, the COO, and board\-level operations in an entrepreneurial, international holding group  
A genuinely varied role combining classic PA/EA work, corporate operations exposure, and private/family support  
A position of real trust with meaningful autonomy and short decision paths  
A small, senior, non\-bureaucratic team  
Central Zurich office location  
Competitive compensation, commensurate with the breadth and seniority of the role  
How to Apply  
Please submit your CV and a short cover note via this platform. The employer is not named at this stage for reasons of strategic confidentiality. Full company details will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates before the interview process.  
We are an equal opportunity employer and treat all applications in strict confidence. jpidc09433ejm jit0833jm jiy26jm

title: Contrôleur de gestion
description:
Contrôleur de gestion  
WHYNESS DVLP\-RH\-Services Sàrl, est un cabinet de recrutement actif en Suisse romande. Nous accompagnons les entreprises dans le recrutement et la sélection de cadres et spécialistes, tout en offrant aux candidats un accompagnement personnalisé dans leurs évolutions et transitions de carrière. Notre approche se distingue par un haut niveau d’exigence, une relation humaine de confiance et une confidentialité absolue, tant pour les entreprises que pour les talents que nous accompagnons. Nos interventions s’inscrivent principalement dans les secteurs de l’horlogerie, de l’industrie et des services, pour des fonctions clés et ou à responsabilité.  
Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons actuellement un / une :  
Contrôleur de gestion (H/F/X)  
Création de fonction \- poste fixe \| Horlogerie \| La Chaux\-de\-Fonds  
Dans le cadre d'une création de poste, nous accompagnons aujourd'hui une PME industrielle d'environ 70 collaborateurs basée à La Chaux\-de\-Fonds et reconnue pour son savoir\-faire dans la sous\-traitance horlogère.  
Afin d'accompagner sa croissance et de renforcer le pilotage de sa performance, nous recherchons un(e) :  
Contrôleur de Gestion Industriel (H/F)  
Votre mission  
Rattaché(e) à la Direction, vous prenez la responsabilité de créer, structurer et développer la fonction contrôle de gestion au sein de l'entreprise.  
Véritable partenaire des équipes opérationnelles et de la Direction, vous apportez une vision claire et factuelle de la performance économique de l'entreprise. Votre rôle consiste à transformer les données financières et industrielles en indicateurs pertinents permettant d'orienter les décisions stratégiques et opérationnelles.  
Dans cette fonction à forte autonomie, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :  
•Mettre en place les outils, méthodes et indicateurs de contrôle de gestion adaptés à l'activité industrielle  
•Construire et assurer le suivi des tableaux de bord de pilotage destinés à la Direction et aux responsables de département  
•Analyser les coûts de production, les marges, les écarts et la rentabilité des différentes activités  
•Participer à l'élaboration des prix de revient et des analyses de rentabilité par produit, client ou activité  
•Accompagner les responsables de production dans le suivi de leurs indicateurs et la compréhension des résultats  
•Identifier les leviers d'amélioration de la performance industrielle et financière  
•Participer à l'établissement des budgets, forecasts et plans d'action  
•Réaliser des analyses ponctuelles destinées à soutenir les décisions stratégiques de l'entreprise  
•Structurer et fiabiliser les données issues des différents systèmes de gestion  
•Participer à l'évolution des outils de reporting et à l'amélioration des processus de pilotage  
Votre profil  
•Formation supérieure en Finance, Contrôle de Gestion ou Économie d'entreprise (HEG, Université ou équivalent)  
•Première expérience réussie dans une fonction de contrôle de gestion en environnement industriel suisse  
•Bonne compréhension des mécanismes de production et des enjeux liés aux coûts industriels  
•Solides capacités d'analyse, de synthèse et d'interprétation des données  
•Excellente maîtrise d'Excel ainsi qu'une forte aisance avec les outils informatiques  
•Expérience avec un ERP industriel et idéalement avec des outils de Business Intelligence (Power BI ou équivalent)  
•Sensibilité aux systèmes d'information et à la qualité des données  
•Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et à construire une fonction nouvellement créée  
•Excellentes compétences relationnelles et de communication, vous permettant d'interagir efficacement avec des interlocuteurs variés, de l'atelier à la Direction  
•Personnalité pragmatique, rigoureuse, proactive et orientée résultats  
Notre client vous offre :  
•Une opportunité rare de créer et développer une fonction stratégique au sein d'une entreprise reconnue dans son domaine  
•Une grande autonomie et une forte proximité avec la Direction  
•Un environnement industriel stimulant, mêlant expertise technique et exigence de qualité  
•Un rôle transverse au coeur des décisions de l'entreprise  
•La possibilité d'avoir un impact concret et durable sur la performance de l'organisation  
•Des conditions d'engagement en adéquation avec les responsabilités du poste  
Vous souhaitez relever un défi entrepreneurial au sein d'une PME agile et reconnue, où votre expertise contribuera directement à structurer le pilotage et la performance de l'entreprise ?

Chez WHYNESS, chaque candidature est avant tout une rencontre.  
Nous prenons le temps de comprendre votre parcours, votre savoir\-faire et vos aspirations.  
Notre engagement :  
Vous rencontrer pour comprendre qui vous êtes  
Mettre en valeur votre expertise  
Vous accompagner avec transparence et exigence  
Transformer une opportunité en collaboration durable  
Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre dossier de candidature en toute confidentialité. jpid3f73543jm jpit0833jm jpiy26jm

title: Human Factors Engineer & Service Lead
description:
At Ypsomed, we are shaping the future of medical technology together \- with the aim of sustainably improving the quality of life for people with chronic conditions. We promote an open corporate culture in which diversity is valued, and new perspectives are welcome. Our employees take responsibility, work in an interdisciplinary manner and develop innovative solutions with real added value for society.  
As our Human Factors Engineer \& Service Lead, you will build and grow Ypsomed's Human Factors service offering for pharmaceutical partners worldwide. You will advise customers on Human Factors strategies, lead international HF programs, and contribute to innovative combination products. With your expertise, you will help deliver user\-centered solutions that support successful regulatory approvals.  
Human Factors Engineer \& Service Lead \| 80 \- 100%  
Ref. No. 7961  
Location: Burgdorf \| Hybrid  
Your main tasks  
Take end\-to\-end responsibility for establishing Human Factors (HF) as a service offering and drive the acquisition of HF service projects in close collaboration with Business Development  
Act as a trusted advisor to pharmaceutical customers on HF strategies for combination products, with a strong focus on efficient regulatory pathways and ensuring that service offerings are aligned with customer needs  
Conduct and coordinate international HF studies, including setting timelines and budgets and planning, monitoring, and documenting formative, summative, and comparative use HF studies, including studies involving large participant cohorts  
Manage external consultants, vendors, and testing facilities as required  
Lead or support HF activities related to Instructions for Use (IFU) and user interfaces as part of the overall HF program  
Create, maintain, and review usability engineering documentation required for regulatory submissions, such as study reports, HF reports, and threshold analyses, in close collaboration with customer teams and internal stakeholders  
Collaborate closely within the Science \& Evidence team to translate insights from HF studies and user populations into strategic publications, evidence\-generation activities, and market differentiation  
Stay current with the global HF regulatory landscape and contribute to shaping Ypsomed’s position in collaboration with industry bodies and consortium representatives  
Your profile  
A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Factors, Ergonomics, Usability Engineering, Product Design, Psychology, or a related field, combined with at least 7 years of professional experience as a Human Factors consultant, including experience within the combination product or related medical device industry  
An entrepreneurial mindset, a strong sense of ownership, strong business acumen, and a clear understanding of how to develop, position, and scale value\-adding service offerings in a customer\-focused environment  
Extensive hands\-on experience in planning, conducting, and documenting large\-scale Human Factors studies for medical devices and/or combination products, as well as strong project management skills and proven experience managing multiple complex projects simultaneously  
Experience with international development programs and regulatory submissions across key markets, including the United States (FDA), the European Union (EU MDR), China (NMPA), and Canada (Health Canada)  
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with English proficiency at C1 level or above; German is an asset. Demonstrated ability to work effectively across cultures in diverse, international environments  
Willingness to travel internationally approximately 20% of the time, including to the United States; authorization to travel to the United States is therefore required  
Ypsomed \- making the treatment of chronic diseases possible  
More than 2,000 employees worldwide develop and produce injection and infusion systems for self\-medication with the Ypsomed Group. We are a successful, rapidly growing, family\-owned company headquartered in Burgdorf (CH) with various production sites and subsidiaries around the world. With our market\-leading products and solutions, we enable people all over the globe to self\-treatment. Despite chronic diseases such as diabetes, obesity, or certain types of cancer, they are provided with the greatest possible quality of life.

title: SALES MANAGER SWISS MARKET 100%
description:
SALES MANAGER SWISS MARKET 100%  
The company  
Chez Swatch, nous adorons surprendre. Qu'il s'agisse de nos collections, de nos collaborations dans les sports d'action ou dans le domaine de l'art, nous avons toujours une approche originale et innovante. Avec nos designs audacieux, qui reflètent constamment l'air du temps tout en attirant les regards, nous voulons faire bouger les choses. C'est ce que nous faisons de mieux, et ce depuis 1983\.  
Notre équipe est un collectif de passionnés, dont le siège se trouve en Suisse et qui est présent dans le monde entier. Nous sommes des visionnaires et des révolutionnaires qui restent fidèles à eux\-mêmes et qui osent aborder les choses différemment. Ensemble, nous souhaitons rendre le monde un peu plus coloré et plus passionnant en restant toujours ouverts à la nouveauté. On pourrait même dire que nous sommes bien plus qu'un simple fabricant de montres.  
Cela vous ressemble ? Alors rejoignez notre équipe.  
Afin de renforcer notre équipe dédiée au marché suisse, basée au siège de Swatch à Bienne (Suisse), nous recherchons actuellement :  
SALES MANAGER SWISS MARKET 100 %  
Job description  
1\. Key Account Management \& Développement commercial pour les marques Swatch et Flik Flak

Élaborer les plans annuels avec objectifs de ventes, distribution et marketing

Gérer les budgets commerciaux et marketing

Manager et accompagner le Regional Sales Manager (1 collaborateur)

Analyser les ouvertures, fermetures et évolutions des points de vente  
5\. Gestion de projets et collaboration transversale  
Participer à l'élaboration du Business Plan annuel  
Piloter les projets liés aux clients

Développer et fidéliser le portefeuille clients en Suisse romande (BE, JU, SO, FR, VS, NE, VD, GE)  
Présenter les collections et conseiller les clients sur l'assortiment, les stocks et le développement des ventes

Formation initiale orientée vente, complétée idéalement par une formation continue dans le domaine commercial (gestion des comptes clés / Key Account Management ou direction des ventes).  
Personnalité orientée client, ouverte et convaincante, dotée d'un excellent sens de l'organisation.

Excellentes compétences en communication et en coordination, notamment dans la collaboration avec les parties prenantes internes.  
Esprit analytique et vision globale, avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs projets simultanément.  
Fortes compétences en négociation et approche professionnelle de la relation client.  
Professional requirements  
Plusieurs années d'expérience (environ 3 à 4 ans) dans la vente sur le terrain ainsi que dans la gestion et le développement de relations clients.  
Connaissance idéale du secteur des biens de consommation (FMCG) et bonne compréhension de cet environnement.  
Expérience avérée dans la collaboration avec des comptes clés (Key Accounts) et des partenaires commerciaux exigeants.  
Maîtrise des applications courantes de la suite Microsoft Office (Word, Excel et PowerPoint).  
Expérience dans l'utilisation des outils RMIS et MyStore.  
Languages  
Excellente maîtrise de l'allemand, du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit  
La connaissance de l'italien constitue un atout supplémentaire

Nous souhaitons que nos collaborateurs se sentent inspirés à donner le meilleur d'eux\-mêmes et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement qui favorise la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion, où chacun se sent écouté, respecté et valorisé.
